# hven options reference

<!-- GENERATED by `hven_options_reference` (`cmake --build <dir> --target options-reference`); do not edit. A test fails when this file and the generator's output differ. -->

Every field of `IpmOptions` and `SqpOptions`, read off the tables the options dump is written over. Names are the dumped names (`dump_options`); a nested struct is flattened under its member name. Defaults are the value-initialized structs'. A range describes the accepted values; an `optional` field's range describes its engaged value and `unset` is always allowed. The one-line descriptions here summarize; the header comments on the structs carry the full contract.

The interior-point options are in `hven/ipm/ipm_options.h`, the SQP options in `hven/sqp/sqp_options.h`, the shared ones in `hven/solver/common_options.h`, and the QP-layer ones (`qp.`, `advanced.ipqp.`) in `hven/qp/qp_options.h` and `hven/qp/qp_types.h`. The rows are also available as data: `ipm_option_info()` and `sqp_option_info()` in `hven/solver/options_reference.h`.

## Common options (`common.`)

Shared by both engines, spelled once; where the defaults or ranges differ they are given per engine.

| Option | Type | IPM default | SQP default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `common.optimality_tol` | `double` | `1e-06` | `1e-06` | finite, > 0 | Optimality tolerance: the IPM reads it against its KKT (and, unless termination.complementarity_tol is set, barrier) measure, the SQP against its stationarity measure and NLP complementarity. |
| `common.feasibility_tol` | `double` | `1e-06` | `1e-06` | finite, > 0 | Feasibility tolerance on the equality and inequality residuals; the SQP also uses it as the bound-activity tolerance of its stationarity measure. |
| `common.max_iterations` | `Index` | `1000` | `100` | IPM: [1, 2147483647]; SQP: [0, 2147483647] | Iteration cap: per phase of `phases` on the IPM, subproblems solved (restoration included) on the SQP. A SolveBudget can only tighten it. |
| `common.max_factorizations` | `optional<Index>` | `unset` | `unset` | unset, or >= 0 | Deterministic work ceiling: KKT factorizations over the whole solve. Reaching it ends the solve with kWorkLimit. Unset is no ceiling. |
| `common.time_limit_seconds` | `optional<double>` | `unset` | `unset` | unset, or finite, > 0 | Wall-clock limit in seconds from solve entry, read at iteration boundaries (kTimeLimit). Not reproducible. Unset is no limit. |
| `common.verbosity` | `Verbosity` | `kSilent` | `kSilent` | one of kSilent, kWarnings, kSummary, kIterations, kDetail | Console output; each rung prints what the one below it prints. |
| `common.threads` | `int` | `HVEN_DEFAULT_IPM_THREADS` | `0` | IPM: >= 1; SQP: >= 0 | Backend thread count for this solver's factorizations. 0 leaves the backend's own default alone (the process-wide MKL_NUM_THREADS then governs). Stored and applied to nothing on Apple. |
| `common.start_level` | `StartLevel` | `kWarm` | `kWarm` | one of kCold, kSeeded, kWarm, kHot | The ceiling on how much of an offered warm start a solve will trust; never a floor. |
| `common.infinite_bound` | `double` | `1e+20` | `1e+20` | > 0 (+inf allowed) | The magnitude at or beyond which a declared bound is absent. kInfinity means every finite value is a real bound. |
| `common.return_best` | `ReturnBest` | `kNever` | `kNever` | one of kNever, kOnLimit, kOnAnyNonOptimal | Which non-optimal exits hand back the best iterate instead of the last one. |

`common.threads` on the interior-point engine defaults to the build's `HVEN_DEFAULT_IPM_THREADS` (8 for the shipped CMake target).

## Interior-point engine: user options

Documented and stable between break windows.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `phases` | `list<IpmPhase>` | `[kOptimize]` | non-empty; each of kOptimize, kSolve | The phase sequence, in order. A kSolve after a kOptimize runs only if that phase was not kOptimal. |
| `termination.complementarity_tol` | `optional<double>` | `unset` | unset, or finite, > 0 | The barrier (complementarity) convergence tolerance. Unset uses common.optimality_tol. |
| `termination.acceptable_iterations` | `Index` | `50` | >= 1 | Consecutive iterates that must sit inside the acceptable tolerances before kAcceptable. |
| `termination.acceptable_stationarity_tol` | `double` | `0.01` | finite, > 0 | Acceptable-level stationarity (dual infeasibility) tolerance. |
| `termination.acceptable_equality_tol` | `double` | `0.001` | finite, > 0 | Acceptable-level equality tolerance. |
| `termination.acceptable_inequality_tol` | `double` | `0.001` | finite, > 0 | Acceptable-level inequality tolerance. |
| `termination.acceptable_complementarity_tol` | `double` | `0.001` | finite, > 0 | Acceptable-level complementarity tolerance. |
| `termination.divergence_stationarity_tol` | `double` | `1000000000000000` | finite, > 0 | Divergence threshold on stationarity. |
| `termination.divergence_equality_tol` | `double` | `1000000000000000` | finite, > 0 | Divergence threshold on the equality residual. |
| `termination.divergence_inequality_tol` | `double` | `1000000000000000` | finite, > 0 | Divergence threshold on the inequality residual. |
| `termination.divergence_complementarity_tol` | `double` | `1000000000000000` | finite, > 0 | Divergence threshold on complementarity. |
| `barrier_initial` | `double` | `0.001` | finite, > 0 | Initial barrier parameter. Must lie in [barrier_min, barrier_max]. |
| `barrier_max` | `double` | `100` | finite, > 0 | Largest barrier parameter. |
| `barrier_min` | `double` | `1e-12` | finite, > 0 | Smallest barrier parameter. Must be <= barrier_max. |
| `fraction_to_boundary` | `double` | `0.99` | (0, 1) | Fraction-to-boundary factor. |
| `bound_push` | `double` | `0.001` | finite, > 0 | Absolute interior push of a bounded variable at solve entry, bound_push * max(1, \|bound\|); also the floor on an inequality row's initial slack. |
| `bound_interval_push` | `double` | `0.01` | (0, 0.5) | Relative push of a two-sided variable, capped at bound_interval_push * (upper - lower). |
| `fixed_variable_treatment` | `IpmFixedVariableTreatment` | `kMakeParameter` | one of kMakeParameter, kMakeConstraint, kRelaxBounds | How a variable with equal bounds is treated. |
| `bound_relax_factor` | `double` | `1e-08` | [0, 0.01] | Every finite variable bound moves outward by this factor times max(1, \|bound\|) before the solve. 0 records bounds verbatim; kRelaxBounds requires > 0. |
| `objective_scale` | `double` | `1` | finite, > 0 | Objective scale factor applied at evaluation. |
| `linear.ordering` | `IpmOrdering` | `kNestedDissection` | one of kMinimumDegree, kNestedDissection, kParallelNestedDissection | Fill-reducing ordering of the KKT factorization. |
| `linear.pivot_strategy` | `IpmPivotStrategy` | `kTwoByTwo` | one of kOneByOne, kTwoByTwo | Pivoting strategy. Pardiso only. |
| `linear.weighted_matching` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | Weighted matching. Pardiso only. |
| `linear.matrix_scaling` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Symmetric scaling: helps on some problem classes, degrades convergence on others. Pardiso only. |
| `linear.pivot_perturbation_exponent` | `int` | `8` | >= 0 | Pivot perturbation exponent: a pivot below 10^-k times the matrix norm is perturbed. |
| `linear.max_refinement_steps` | `int` | `0` | >= 0 | Iterative refinement steps per solve. Must be 0 on Accelerate, which performs none. |
| `linear.solve_parallelism` | `IpmSolveParallelism` | `kAdaptivePartitioning` | one of kAdaptivePartitioning, kSequential | Parallelism of the solve phase. Pardiso only. |
| `linear.conditional_reproducibility` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Conditional numerical reproducibility: bit-reproducible factorization across thread counts. Pardiso only; requires dense_factorization = kNever. |
| `linear.force_analysis` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Force a fresh symbolic analysis on every solve instead of once per solver. |
| `linear.dense_factorization` | `DensePolicy` | `kAuto` | one of kNever, kAlways, kAuto | When the dense factorization arm is used: kAuto takes it for a KKT pattern of order n_kkt <= 167, the sparse backend above. |
| `linear.accelerate_zero_tol` | `double` | `2.2204460492503132e-20` | finite, > 0 | Accelerate's zero (drop) tolerance. Ignored on MKL, validated on every backend. |
| `linear.max_dense_dimension` | `optional<Index>` | `unset` | unset (reserved) | Reserved for a caller's kAuto threshold; only the empty value is accepted. |

## Interior-point engine: advanced options

The research tier (`advanced.`): these fields may change in any milestone, without a break window.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `advanced.acceptance_mode` | `IpmAcceptanceMode` | `kFilter` | one of kClassicMerit, kMerit, kFunnel, kFilter | Step-acceptance test. kFunnel and kFilter require the monitored barrier governor unless never_monotone is set. |
| `advanced.merit_penalty_rule` | `IpmMeritPenaltyRule` | `kSinglePenalty` | one of kSinglePenalty, kFlexible | Penalty rule; read only under kMerit. |
| `advanced.barrier_governor_mode` | `IpmBarrierGovernorMode` | `kMonitored` | one of kClassicAdaptive, kMonitored | Barrier-parameter governor. |
| `advanced.never_monotone` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Accept a funnel or filter test over kClassicAdaptive without the monotone safeguard. Contradicts kMonitored. |
| `advanced.restoration_mode` | `IpmRestorationMode` | `kOff` | one of kOff, kProximalSwitch, kL1Nested | Restoration strategy. |
| `advanced.inertia_mode` | `IpmInertiaMode` | `kClassic` | one of kClassic, kProximalRegularization | Inertia-correction strategy; kClassic assumes the exact Hessian. |
| `advanced.max_second_order_corrections` | `Index` | `0` | >= 0 | Second-order corrections after a first-trial rejection. 0 is off. |
| `advanced.max_extended_backtracks` | `Index` | `0` | >= 0 | Further backtracking trials once the ladder rejects and SOC is exhausted. 0 is off. |
| `advanced.watchdog` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | The watchdog (Chamberlain, Powell, Lemarechal and Pedersen 1982). |
| `advanced.max_restoration_entries` | `Index` | `2` | >= 0 | Restoration entries allowed per phase. 0 refuses restoration. |
| `advanced.max_line_search_backtracks` | `Index` | `2` | >= 0 | Classic backtracking trials per rejected step. |
| `advanced.backtrack_divisor` | `double` | `2` | finite, > 1 | The divisor applied to the step on each backtrack. |
| `advanced.solve_phase_mode` | `IpmSolvePhaseMode` | `kSolveEquations` | one of kOptimize, kOptimizeWithoutObjective, kSolveEquations | What a kSolve phase iterates on. |
| `advanced.optimize_barrier_mode` | `IpmBarrierMode` | `kLoqo` | one of kProbe, kLoqo | Barrier update in the optimality phase. |
| `advanced.solve_barrier_mode` | `IpmBarrierMode` | `kLoqo` | one of kProbe, kLoqo | Barrier update in the feasibility phase. |
| `advanced.optimize_line_search_mode` | `IpmLineSearchMode` | `kAugmentedLagrangian` | one of kAugmentedLagrangian, kLagrangian, kL1, kNone | Merit function in the optimality phase. |
| `advanced.solve_line_search_mode` | `IpmLineSearchMode` | `kNone` | one of kAugmentedLagrangian, kLagrangian, kL1, kNone | Merit function in the feasibility phase. |
| `advanced.step_length_rule` | `IpmStepLengthRule` | `kEqualityMultipliersPrimal` | one of kEqualityMultipliersPrimal, kAllMinimum, kEqualityMultipliersDual, kEqualityMultipliersMaximum | How the step length is shared between primal and multipliers. |
| `advanced.inertia_correction_initial` | `double` | `1e-05` | finite, > 0 | The inertia correction's first Hessian shift. |
| `advanced.inertia_correction_increase` | `double` | `8` | finite, > 1 | The inertia correction's growth factor. |
| `advanced.inertia_correction_decrease` | `double` | `0.333333` | (0, 1) | The inertia correction's decay factor between iterations. |
| `advanced.max_inertia_correction_attempts` | `Index` | `15` | >= 0 | Correction attempts per factorization. 0 disables the ladder. |
| `advanced.skip_unperturbed_attempts` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | Skip the unperturbed factorization attempt while the last four iterations all needed Hessian perturbation. |
| `advanced.negative_slack_reset` | `double` | `1e-12` | finite, > 0 | Reset value for a negative slack. |

## SQP engine: user options

Documented and stable between break windows; includes the `qp.` block.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `termination.acceptable_stationarity_tol` | `double` | `0.01` | finite, > 0 | Acceptable-level stationarity tolerance a failure exit's point is labelled against. |
| `termination.acceptable_equality_tol` | `double` | `0.001` | finite, > 0 | Acceptable-level equality tolerance. |
| `termination.acceptable_inequality_tol` | `double` | `0.001` | finite, > 0 | Acceptable-level inequality tolerance (bounds included). |
| `termination.acceptable_complementarity_tol` | `double` | `0.001` | finite, > 0 | Acceptable-level complementarity tolerance. |
| `trust_region_initial` | `double` | `1` | > 0 (+inf allowed) | The l-infinity trust-region radius the first subproblem is given. +inf means no trust region. |
| `trust_region_max` | `double` | `10000000000` | > 0; >= trust_region_initial unless that is +inf | Ceiling the growth rule expands the radius toward; the value a +inf initial radius's first shrink lands on. |
| `trust_region_min` | `double` | `1e-10` | finite, > 0 | The radius floor: a shrink below it raises a restoration request. Must be <= trust_region_initial and trust_region_max. |
| `caller_step_limit` | `double` | `0` | finite, >= 0 | Caller-unit step limit r: every QP's variable box is narrowed to \|dx_j\| <= r * (1 + \|x_j\|). 0 is off. |
| `qp.primal_regularization` | `double` | `1e-08` | finite, >= 0 | Primal regularization magnitude on the (1,1) block of the walk's KKT matrix, centred at the iterate. 0 is a real setting (no regularization). |
| `qp.dual_regularization` | `double` | `1e-08` | finite, >= 0 | Dual regularization magnitude on the (2,2) block, so an over-determined working set stays solvable. 0 is a real setting. |
| `qp.feasibility_tol` | `double` | `1e-09` | finite, > 0 | The QP's own feasibility tolerance. |
| `qp.optimality_tol` | `double` | `1e-09` | finite, > 0 | The QP's own optimality tolerance. |
| `qp.max_iterations` | `optional<Index>` | `unset` | unset, or >= 1 | Minor-iteration cap for one QP solve. Unset derives the cap from the subproblem's size; an engaged value is an absolute cap. |
| `qp.max_schur_border_dimension` | `Index` | `128` | >= 0 | Largest Schur-complement border the walk admits before it refactorizes. 0 refactorizes on every working-set change. |
| `qp.schur_condition_max` | `double` | `1000000000` | finite, >= 1 | Ceiling on the Schur border's condition estimate; beyond it the walk refactorizes. |
| `qp.working_set_algebra` | `QpWorkingSetAlgebra` | `kSchurBorder` | one of kRefactorize, kSchurBorder | How the walk updates its factorization when the working set changes. |
| `qp.trust_region_radius` | `double` | `inf` | >= 0 (+inf allowed) | l-infinity trust-region radius about the solve's start point, fixed for the engine's lifetime. +inf disables it exactly. |
| `qp.independent_working_set` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | Keep the walk's working set linearly independent. False disables the check. |
| `qp.hessian_known_convex` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Caller assertion that H is positive semidefinite, accepted by the walk's convexity certificate in place of its structural test. Never verified. |
| `qp_mode` | `QpMode` | `kWalk` | one of kWalk, kSsn, kIpqp | Which QP kernel the driver's subproblems go through. |
| `row_scaling` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | The problem-scaling layer: solve a diagonally rescaled problem, results mapped back to caller units. |
| `scaling_max_gradient` | `double` | `100` | finite, > 0 | The inf-norm the scaled objective gradient and each scaled Jacobian row are aimed at. |
| `scaling_factor_max` | `double` | `1000000000000` | finite, >= 1 | Symmetric clamp on every row-layer factor, to [1/limit, limit]. |
| `row_scaling_power_of_two` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Round each row factor to the nearest power of two. |
| `column_scaling` | `SqpColumnScaling` | `kAuto` | one of kOff, kAlways, kAuto | The column (variable) layer of problem scaling. |
| `column_scaling_threshold` | `double` | `67108864` | finite, >= 1 | kAuto's gate: the column factors' max/min spread at which a problem counts as badly scaled. |
| `column_scaling_factor_max` | `double` | `1024` | finite, >= 1 | Symmetric clamp on the column factors under kAlways. |
| `project_start_point` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | Project the start point onto the declared box, or take it verbatim. |
| `hessian_mode` | `SqpHessianMode` | `kExact` | one of kExact, kLbfgsDamped | The curvature source of the subproblems. |
| `lbfgs_memory` | `Index` | `10` | >= 1 | The L-BFGS window length m under kLbfgsDamped. |
| `linear.dense_factorization` | `DensePolicy` | `kAuto` | one of kNever, kAlways, kAuto | When the dense factorization arm is used: kAuto takes it for each analyzed pattern of order n <= 105, the sparse backend above, so one solve can use both. |
| `linear.max_dense_dimension` | `optional<Index>` | `unset` | unset (reserved) | Reserved for a caller's kAuto threshold; only the empty value is accepted. |

## SQP engine: advanced options

The research tier (`advanced.`, including `advanced.ipqp.`): these fields may change in any milestone, without a break window.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `advanced.second_order_correction` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | Second-order correction: a rejected trial whose violation increased gets one hot-started re-solve before the radius shrinks (the Maratos-effect defense). |
| `advanced.adaptive_dual_regularization` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | Schedule the QP's dual regularization down with the KKT residual instead of leaving it at the engine's fixed value. |
| `advanced.make_strategy` | `callable` | `unset` | empty (the funnel) or a factory returning non-null | Factory for the globalization strategy, called once per solve. Empty means the funnel. |
| `advanced.warm_full_step` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | The full-step-first warm rule: a warm solve begins in the funnel's full-step mode with a watchdog. |
| `advanced.elastic_ladder_early_exit` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Stop the elastic penalty ladder once an escalation leaves the solution where the previous rung left it. |
| `advanced.crash_basis` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Seed a cold solve's first QP working set from the activity geometry at x0. |
| `advanced.elastic_rung_engine` | `SqpElasticRungEngine` | `kWalk` | one of kWalk, kTier | Which engine solves the elastic ladder's rungs. |
| `advanced.ipqp_reseed_after_disproval` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | After a disproval, offer the fallback's certified dual blocks to the tier's next entry. |
| `advanced.ipqp.max_iterations` | `optional<Index>` | `unset` | unset, or >= 1 | Iteration budget for the tier's Mehrotra loop. Unset derives it from the subproblem's size. |
| `advanced.ipqp.hard_max_iterations` | `Index` | `60` | >= 1 | The hard cap of last resort, never derived. Per attempt, not per subproblem. |
| `advanced.ipqp.max_factorizations` | `optional<Index>` | `unset` | unset, or >= 1 | Factorization budget for the tier, enforced before every factorization. Unset is 3 times the effective iteration budget. |
| `advanced.ipqp.barrier_initial` | `double` | `0.01` | finite, > 0 | The cold starting barrier parameter and the ceiling of the warm-restart mu_0 clamp. Must be >= barrier_min. |
| `advanced.ipqp.barrier_min` | `double` | `1e-12` | finite, > 0 | The floor of the mu_0 clamp and the tier's barrier-decay floor. Must be <= barrier_initial. |
| `advanced.ipqp.primal_regularization_initial` | `double` | `8` | finite, in [regularization_min, regularization_max] | Initial primal regularization rho_0 of the proximal (rho, delta) schedule. |
| `advanced.ipqp.dual_regularization_initial` | `double` | `8` | finite, in (0, regularization_max] | Initial dual regularization delta_0 of the (rho, delta) schedule. |
| `advanced.ipqp.regularization_min` | `double` | `1e-10` | finite, > 0 | The floor the (rho, delta) ladder's gated decrease may never cross. |
| `advanced.ipqp.regularization_max` | `double` | `1000000` | finite, >= regularization_min | The ceiling the ladder's inertia-demanded growth may never cross. |
| `advanced.ipqp.regularization_decrease` | `double` | `0.1` | (0, 1) | The ladder's gated multiplicative decrease factor. |
| `advanced.ipqp.fraction_to_boundary` | `double` | `0.995` | (0, 1) | Fraction-to-boundary parameter both the affine and corrector steps are clipped by. |
| `advanced.ipqp.face_ratio_threshold` | `double` | `0.01` | (0, 1) | The ratio threshold kappa of the face-classification rule (active iff s < kappa z). |
| `advanced.ipqp.convergence_slack` | `double` | `100` | finite, >= 1 | The barrier phase converges to this multiple of the QP layer's relative tolerances; the exact refinement owns the last decades. |
| `advanced.ipqp.ruiz_equilibration` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | Ruiz equilibration inside the tier, unscaled on export. |
| `advanced.ipqp.warm_repair` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | The warm-seed repair (positivity clamps plus a two-scalar shift) before a warm restart is trusted. |
| `advanced.ipqp.max_warm_iterations` | `Index` | `15` | >= 0 | The warm-kill rule's iteration budget: a warm start overrunning it restarts cold once. |
| `advanced.ipqp.barrier_adoption_factor` | `double` | `1` | finite, >= 0 | kappa_mu in the mu_0 clamp. 0 disables adoption of the payload's barrier value. |
| `advanced.ipqp.stall_window` | `Index` | `5` | >= 1 | The early-stall detector's window width, in accepted iterations. |
| `advanced.ipqp.max_consecutive_escapes` | `Index` | `3` | >= 1 | Consecutive escapes within one SQP solve after which the tier is retired for the remainder of that solve. |
| `advanced.ipqp.farkas_gate` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | Farkas corroboration of an infeasible-suspect escape. May arm the evidence block; never certifies. |
| `advanced.ipqp.hoist_symbolic_analysis` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | Cross-major symbolic reuse. False forces a fresh symbolic pass every major. |
| `advanced.ipqp.require_final_inertia` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | Require the final unregularized inertia read; false downgrades every certificate. |
| `advanced.ipqp.barrier_initial_rule` | `IpqpBarrierInitialRule` | `kFixed` | one of kFixed, kComplementarity | How the solve-entry cold start sets mu_0. |
| `advanced.ipqp.barrier_residual_floor` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Raise the corrector target to a residual-proportional floor. |
| `advanced.ipqp.ladder_skip_after` | `Index` | `3` | >= 0 | The inertia ladder's zero trial is skipped once this many consecutive iterations needed a modification. |
| `advanced.qp_dump_dir` | `string` | `unset` | empty (off) or a directory path; required when qp_dump_policy is on | Directory the walk's QP dump files are written to. Empty is off. |
| `advanced.qp_dump_policy` | `QpDumpPolicy` | `kOff` | one of kOff, kFailed, kAll | Which walk solves are dumped. |
| `advanced.ssn_proximal_carry` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Read the proximal carry off an ingested SqpWarmStart for the first SSN subproblem. |
| `advanced.ssn_certify_from_face` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Read the certifying exit's second-order evidence off the face-EQP factorization, saving one factorization. |
| `advanced.ssn_sigma_rule` | `SsnSigmaRule` | `kLadder` | one of kLadder, kResidualArmed, kResidualAlways | The SSN regularization (sigma) rule. |
| `advanced.ssn_hint_rule` | `SsnHintRule` | `kIterationZeroFree` | one of kIterationZeroFree, kWatchdog | How the hinted first SSN step is protected. |
| `advanced.ssn_infeasibility_rule` | `SsnInfeasibilityRule` | `kSymptoms` | one of kSymptoms, kFarkasGated | What turns an SSN infeasibility suspicion into an exit. |
| `advanced.max_consecutive_qp_failures` | `Index` | `3` | >= 1 | Subproblem failures in a row the driver routes at one iterate before the next one ends the solve. |
| `advanced.qp_iteration_limit_retry` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Re-solve a subproblem that spent its whole minor budget, once, at twice the cap. |
| `advanced.qp_failure_step` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | Judge a failed walk subproblem's usable iterate as a trial step. |
| `advanced.qp_retry_regularization_first` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Take the regularization retry rung ahead of the cold and algebra rungs after a dependent-blocker or zero-motion termination. |
| `advanced.restoration_proximity` | `double` | `0` | finite, >= 0 | Restoration proximity weight zeta on 1/2 zeta \|\|D (x - x_k)\|\|^2. 0 is off. Experimental. Refused with kLbfgsDamped when > 0. |
| `advanced.equality_basis` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | Split the equality rows into an independent set and a dependent set; every QP carries only the independent set. |
| `advanced.elastic_witness_start` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Start each elastic walk rung at the feasible witness point. |
| `advanced.elastic_last_optimal_rung` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | A ladder rung that fails above a solved rung reports the solved rung instead. |
| `advanced.restoration_resume_reduction` | `double` | `0.1` | [0, 1) | Sufficient-reduction resume fraction of the entry violation. 0 is off. |
| `advanced.restoration_stall_factorizations` | `Index` | `5000` | >= 0 | The restoration phase's stall window: the phase ends when its best violation has not fallen by 10% over this many factorizations and at least five passes; a window of 0 means after five passes. |
| `advanced.max_unproductive_restoration_entries` | `Index` | `1` | >= 0 | Consecutive restoration re-entries with no step from a solved subproblem accepted since the previous resume that a solve tolerates. |
| `advanced.restoration_max_total_factorizations` | `optional<Index>` | `unset` | unset, or >= 0 | The cumulative restoration budget in factorizations; unset derives max(20000, 4 x the main loop's factorizations) at each entry. |
| `advanced.lbfgs_update_on_reject` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Under kLbfgsDamped, also offer the pair of a rejected trial. |
| `advanced.lbfgs_nonlinear_only` | `bool` | `false` | true or false | Under kLbfgsDamped, let B act on the nonlinear variables only. |
| `advanced.max_lbfgs_full_memory_dimension` | `Index` | `400` | >= 0 | Under kLbfgsDamped, a full-memory damped BFGS replaces the L-BFGS window at or below this dimension. 0 is never. |
| `advanced.restoration_curvature` | `SqpRestorationCurvature` | `kModelThenRegularized` | one of kModel, kRegularized, kModelThenRegularized | The curvature the restoration phase's QPs carry. |
| `advanced.max_restoration_entries` | `Index` | `10` | >= 0 | Restoration entries allowed per solve. 0 refuses restoration. |
| `advanced.trust_region_growth` | `SqpTrustRegionGrowth` | `kRatio` | one of kRatio, kRatioOrFeasibilityStep, kAnyAccepted | When an accepted step earns the trust-region radius a larger value. |
| `advanced.ssn_farkas_residual_tol` | `double` | `1e-06` | (0, 1) | SSN Farkas certificate's relative-residual threshold (kFarkasGated only). |
| `advanced.ssn_uncertain_tol` | `double` | `0.1` | [0, 1) | SSN uncertain-set entering threshold on \|alpha - beta\|. 0 disables the set. |
| `advanced.ssn_lm_sigma_c` | `double` | `1` | finite, > 0 | SSN Levenberg-Marquardt sizing coefficient c (residual sigma rules only). |
| `advanced.ssn_lm_sigma_exponent` | `double` | `2` | [1, 2] | SSN Levenberg-Marquardt sizing exponent p in c * min(r, r^p). |
| `advanced.restoration_elastic_seed` | `bool` | `true` | true or false | Offer the elastic ladder's step as a restoration candidate at the ladder-unusable site. |
| `advanced.elastic_rho0_headroom_rungs` | `Index` | `1` | [1, 6] | Rungs of the penalty ladder the evidence-placed first rung leaves below the ceiling. |
| `advanced.adaptive_dual_regularization_max` | `double` | `1e-08` | [1e-12, 1] | Ceiling of the adaptive dual-regularization schedule. |
